text:
maya: Heads-up — we've seen different request-id headers and log redaction behaviors across SDKs (node/python/go). Node emits `x-request-id`, python uses `request_id` in metadata, go sometimes drops it. Also Otel spans aren't consistently correlated with our logs. Anyone else seeing this?
thomas: yup, saw it in prod yesterday — correlation broke for a subset of RPCs. Node attaches the header at the edge but our logging middleware strips it before logging, so the logs end up orphaned.
ania: we also have inconsistent default logging levels: node defaults to info, go builds in CI set debug in a couple services which floods logs and surfaces PII we expected to be redacted.
maya: Proposal: standardize on `X-Request-ID` header plus `trace_id` and `span_id` fields in structured logs, add a small cross-language middleware that injects these into each logger scope, and expose an OpenTelemetry hook so teams can map trace resource attributes to our logging schema.
thomas: +1. Also we need a default redactor pipeline that removes SSNs, credit-card-like tokens, and emails from free-text logs, but allow teams to register custom redactors. Keep default conservative to avoid app breakage.
devex-bot: RFC draft uploaded: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/2026/telemetry-sdk-parity — includes API sketches for Node/Python/Go hooks and migration notes.
lucas-sre: Can we add a small e2e test in CI that emits a trace -> logs -> checks correlation and redaction? A sample app that runs locally and in CI would be perfect.
ania: I can spin up a minimal sample app (python + node) showing middleware, OTEL bridging, and a test that asserts `X-Request-ID` retained across retries and that redaction replaced emails with `<redacted-email>`.
maya: Great — can we aim for a beta in the next sprint? I'll add a ticket to the board with acceptance criteria: standard header, structured log keys, Otel hook, default redactor + opt-out, sample app, e2e test.
thomas: One more detail: ensure retries preserve the original request-id and trace relationship; do not auto-regenerate on internal retries unless explicitly requested. This helped debugging in the past.
maya: noted. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
